data.name: Vigilance.Subtitle
data.value: The file the firm keeps on its client under anti-money laundering rules: identity documents, beneficial owners, risk level and next review date. It stays within the firm.

data.name: Vigilance.Status.Missing.Hint
data.value: No file for this client yet: the engagement letter cannot be signed.

data.name: Vigilance.Status.Incomplete.Hint
data.value: The company register extract, the manager's ID, the verification date or a beneficial owner is missing.

data.name: Vigilance.Status.ReviewDue.Hint
data.value: The review date has passed: read the file again and save it.

data.name: Vigilance.Status.UpToDate.Hint
data.value: The client is identified and its risk assessed.

data.name: Vigilance.Status.Ended.Hint
data.value: The file is kept for five years after the relationship ends.

data.name: Vigilance.Level.High.Hint
data.value: Reviewed every year, enhanced due diligence

data.name: Vigilance.Level.MustBeHigh
data.value: A politically exposed person or a high-risk country requires the high level.

data.name: Vigilance.Evidence.CompanyRegistration
data.value: Company register extract less than three months old

data.name: Vigilance.Evidence.Hint
data.value: The company register extract and the manager's ID are required. Lettra records which documents were received; the originals stay in the firm's file.

data.name: Vigilance.Owners.Hint
data.value: The individuals who hold more than 25% of the capital or voting rights, or who control the company. Failing that, the legal representative.

data.name: Vigilance.Justification.Hint
data.value: Required for a low or high risk: this is what the professional body reads during an inspection.

data.name: Vigilance.EndedOn.Hint
data.value: When the client leaves the firm: the file is then kept for five years and may be erased afterwards.

data.name: Vigilance.Saved
data.value: File saved. Next review set according to the risk.

data.name: Vigilance.NotSaved
data.value: The file was not saved: fix the highlighted fields.

data.name: Error.Vigilance.DateInFuture
data.value: A verification, review or end date cannot be in the future.

data.name: Error.Vigilance.OwnerNameInvalid
data.value: Each beneficial owner has a name of at most 120 characters.

data.name: Error.Vigilance.OwnerShareInvalid
data.value: A capital or voting share is above 25% and at most 100%; control or a legal representative has no share.

data.name: Error.Vigilance.SharesOver100
data.value: The shares add up to more than 100%.

data.name: Error.Vigilance.LevelTooLow
data.value: A politically exposed person or a high-risk country requires the high level.

data.name: Error.Vigilance.JustificationRequired
data.value: Give the reason for a low or high risk level.

data.name: Error.Vigilance.JustificationTooLong
data.value: The reason fits in 1,000 characters at most.

data.name: Vigilance.Owners.FromRegister.Hint
data.value: Reads the beneficial owners declared in the national business register (INPI) and compares them with the asset-freeze register. Review, complete and save: nothing is saved without you.

data.name: Vigilance.Owners.FromRegister.Done
data.value: {0} beneficial owner(s) taken from the register. Review, then save the file.

data.name: Vigilance.Owners.FromRegister.Empty
data.value: No beneficial owner is declared in the register for SIREN {0}.

data.name: Vigilance.Owners.FromRegister.NoSiren
data.value: The company profile has no SIREN: fill it in to query the register.

data.name: Vigilance.Owners.FreezeAlert
data.value: A name looks like a person listed in the asset-freeze register: {0}. Check it is not a namesake before any transaction, record your analysis and, if in doubt, do not continue the relationship.
